extDescription.message: Automatically disables other extensions on sensitive websites (like your bank) and turns them back on when you leave.

badgeOnTitle.message: Exterminator: protected mode active ({count} extension(s) turned off)

alertMessage.message: Reason: {detail}. Review this in the Exterminator settings.

intrusionTitle.message: Extension turned on during protected mode

intrusionMessage.message: {names} was turned off again. Reload your protected tabs to be safe.

clipboardJustification.message: Clear the clipboard after leaving a protected page

logCleanup.message: Cleared cookies and site data for {site}

logIntrusion.message: Turned on during protected mode and turned off again: {names}

riskAllSites.message: can read and change all websites

perm_webRequest.message: can read network traffic and submitted forms

perm_webRequestBlocking.message: can intercept and modify network traffic

perm_cookies.message: can read cookies and login sessions

perm_management.message: can turn other extensions on and off

perm_nativeMessaging.message: can communicate with programs on your computer

perm_proxy.message: can reroute all your internet traffic

perm_tabs.message: can see the addresses of all your tabs

perm_contextMenus.message: add items to the right-click menu

perm_activeTab.message: access the current tab after a click

perm_identity.message: sign in with your Google account

perm_declarativeNetRequest.message: block or modify requests to websites

perm_idle.message: detect whether you are using your computer

popupIncognito.message: ⚠ Exterminator does not run in Incognito. Turn on "Allow in Incognito" for Exterminator in chrome://extensions.

popupAlerts.message: ⚠ {count} extension(s) removed from "Always on" after a permission change. Check the settings.

logOutWhenLeaving.message: Log out when leaving (clear cookies and site data)

pausedStatus.message: ⏸ Paused for {sites} (at most one hour). Leaving these sites or opening another protected site ends the pause.

incognitoWarningHtml.message: ⚠ Not protected in Incognito. If other extensions are allowed in Incognito, they simply stay on on your bank there. Go to chrome://extensions, click "Details" for Exterminator and turn on "Allow in Incognito".

alertsIntro.message: These extensions gained new permissions after an update. They will be turned off on protected pages again until you re-approve them.

sitesIntro.message: On these sites (and their subdomains) all extensions are turned off, except the allowed ones. Protected mode stays active as long as a tab of a protected site is open anywhere.

noSites.message: No sites yet. Add one above, or click the Exterminator icon while on a site.

fieldDetectionLabel.message: Protect every page with a password field

fieldDetectionHelpHtml.message: Extensions are also turned off on sites that aren't in your list (only "Always on" stays on). The tab stays protected until you leave that website. Chrome will ask for access to all websites for this; Exterminator only checks whether such a field exists and reads nothing else.

detectionDenied.message: Without access to websites, Exterminator cannot detect sensitive fields.

sensitiveHelp.message: Credit card number, CVC, expiry date, one-time codes (2FA), IBAN and social security / national ID numbers.

exceptionsHelp.message: Sensitive fields on these sites (and their subdomains) never trigger protection, for example sites with a hidden login form on every page. Sites in your protected list are always protected.

clipboardHelp.message: The clipboard is emptied before extensions come back, so a copied password or account number can't be read. Note: this also happens if you meant to paste something on another site.

cleanupHelpHtml.message: For each site above you can also turn on Log out when leaving: the site's cookies and site data are then cleared, so extensions can't take over your session.

alwaysOnIntroHtml.message: These extensions stay on on all protected pages (including pages with sensitive fields), for example your password manager. Everything else, including newly installed extensions, is turned off. If an extension here gains new permissions after an update, it is removed from this list automatically.

managedByPolicy.message: managed by policy, cannot be turned off

confirmHighRisk.message: "{name}" is high risk: {reasons}. It will be able to read along on your protected pages.

confirmManageNote.message: It can also turn other extensions on; Exterminator turns those off again right away, but only trust it if you are sure it is reliable.

tipDetection.message: Password fields are detected even when hidden or inside (open) Shadow DOM — you never need to click them.

tipReload.message: A protected tab is reloaded when it was loaded while an extension that this site doesn't allow was still on, so scripts that extension had injected are gone.

tipMultipleHtml.message: With several protected sites open at once, only extensions allowed on all open sites stay on.

tipManualEnable.message: If an extension is turned on during protected mode, it is turned off again right away and you get a notification. Add it to "Always on" or use "Pause".

tipManagers.message: Extensions that can manage other extensions (like 1Password) may be "Always on"; if they turn another extension on during protected mode, Exterminator turns it off again immediately.

tipUninstall.message: Don't remove or disable Exterminator while protected mode is active: extensions it turned off would stay off.

tipSiteAccess.message: Extra layer: restrict the site access of extensions you rarely need on all sites to "On click" in chrome://extensions.

logFrameRace.message: A protected frame from {site} loaded before extensions were turned off

frameRaceMessage.message: A protected frame from {site} started before other extensions were off. Reload the page to be safe (you may need to restart a payment step).

disableFailedTitle.message: Could not turn off an extension

disableFailedMessage.message: {names} is still on while a protected page is open. Close the protected page or remove the extension.

tipFrames.message: A protected site loaded inside another page (for example a bank's payment frame in a web shop) also turns protection on.

logCleanupIncognito.message: Incognito cookies and site data for {site} could not be cleared; close all incognito windows to remove them

logStorageUnrestricted.message: Chrome could not shield settings from web pages, so automatic field detection stays off

storageUnrestrictedMessage.message: This Chrome version cannot keep Exterminator's settings out of reach of web pages, so the field detector is not injected. Protection for your configured sites still works.

staleTabMessage.message: A protected page from {site} that can't be reloaded (a popup or a generated page) was open while other extensions were still on. Close it and open it again from the site to be safe.

clipboardFailedMessage.message: Exterminator could not clear the clipboard before turning extensions back on. Copy something harmless to overwrite it.

allowAgainUnavailable.message: Created by an older version: review it and turn it back on in the lists below.
